embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization
fields.value: Tencent Hunyuan — The paper introduces Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO), a forward-process reinforcement-learning method for flow-matching models that reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as attraction toward matched positive samples.

fields.name: DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models
fields.value: Alibaba Group — DiVid is a diagnostic framework that decomposes video-generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions — Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera — each measured with reproducible computer-vision pipelines alongside quality and instruction-faithfulness metrics.

fields.name: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
fields.value: Microsoft — CLoSeR augments a streaming 3D-reconstruction foundation model (LoGeR) with loop-closure detection to perform kilometer-scale 3D reconstruction from monocular video, correcting accumulated tracking drift over long sequences.

fields.name: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry
fields.value: Stability AI (flag) — 4Director is a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from an input image as a canonical mesh, and its motion is specified by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame.

fields.name: VR-JEPA: Learning Contrastive-State Latent Guidance for Generation-based Video Reasoning
fields.value: Tencent — The paper targets generation-based visual reasoning, where a video diffusion model is used to "think" by generating a rollout, but plain generation lacks guidance on which visual states matter for the reasoning task and is prone to physical/structural inconsistencies.

fields.name: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
fields.value: Stability AI (flag) — SemanTok is a flexible video tokenizer for autoregressive video generation that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads reconstructing those features from each retained token prefix, so early coarse tokens carry stronger global semantics.

fields.name: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
fields.value: Google DeepMind (flag) — This is a survey/unifying-framework paper on 4D (dynamic) scene reconstruction, covering both implicit Neural Radiance Field (4D NeRF) and explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) approaches.

fields.name: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
fields.value: ByteDance Inc. — RSIGame is a framework for autonomous agentic game development that pairs a local explore-diagnose-improve loop with a global quality-monitoring loop to recursively self-improve LLM-generated games in the Godot and Phaser engines, evaluated on a new GameCraft-Bench benchmark (140 tasks across 15 gam

fields.name: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
fields.value: NVIDIA; co-authors also from University of Oxford and MIT — Video world models often generate visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles, and this paper argues language has not yet been fully exploited as a representation of physical processes.

fields.name: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
fields.value: Meta — PartiCam is a training-free, inference-time method for making video diffusion models follow a specified camera trajectory, addressing drift in existing score-modulation guidance and the data/generalization cost of training-based camera-control approaches.

fields.name: No Corners Cut: State-Grounded Transitions for Mid-Stream Prompt Switches in Video Generation
fields.value: Kuaishou — The paper proposes a training-free VLM planner plus a distillation technique (SpanDMD) to prevent "corner cutting" — implausible shortcuts — when streaming video generators must respond to mid-stream prompt switches, evaluated on a new OpenTrans-360 benchmark of 1,800 prompt switches.

fields.name: MeshOctave: Vertex Split-and-Rewire Cascades for Native Mesh Generation
fields.value: Meshy AI (several authors, including the corresponding-adjacent "Project Leader" marker and a footnote stating one author's contribution "was done while interning at Meshy AI"). **Flag: BORDERLINE** — Current artist-style mesh generation methods either generate connectivity tokens one at a time (slow) or rely on heuristic connectivity decoders.

fields.name: MegaAvatar: Controllable Talking Avatar Generation
fields.value: Tencent; footnote: "done during Junyao Gao's internship at AIPD, Tencent") — MegaAvatar is a controllable talking-avatar generation framework built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion model.

fields.name: Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction
fields.value: Meta; Tarun Yenamandra's work was done during a Meta Reality Labs Research internship, with primary affiliation TU Munich — Lens flares are camera artifacts that degrade downstream applications such as 3D scene reconstruction, and existing removal methods handle small flares but struggle with large, full-frame reflective flares; consistent flare representation across multiple viewpoints had not previously been explored.

fields.name: Game-Guided Skill Discovery through Self-Play for Playable Agent Control
fields.value: NVIDIA — The paper presents Game-Guided Skill Discovery (GGSD), which uses self-play in games to discover a small set of motor skills that a human can control directly, like a video-game character controller.
